'''Dalsande''' was a city in [[Essenia]], which was part of the [[Ten Nations]]. Other than the name, nothing else is known about it. {{ref|{{bwb}}, Ch10|Ch10}}

Its name translated into the Common Tongue is possibly "Rose Bowl" - from the [[Old Tongue]] words ''dal'' (meaning "bowl") and ''ande'' (meaning "rose"). {{ref|{{twotc}}, Old Tongue Dictionary}}
